title: Maintenance shift handoff note: what's running, what's down, what's pending
summary: A focused session handoff: running assets, down assets, and pending work so the next crew does not rediscover the plant from zero.

blocks.eyebrow: Focused session handoff — fictional plant snapshot
blocks.title: What's running, what's down, what's pending
blocks.body: Outgoing crew fills this once. Incoming crew reads it before touching a wrench. Example rows invent a small packaging line — swap in your asset IDs.

blocks.heading: Running (watch items only)
rows: Seam temp trending high — check at 14:00
New chuck jaws installed mid-shift; torque OK
Belt tracking nudged; recheck after warm-up
Duty cycle high on hot day — watch cut-out
blocks.caption: Do not list every happy pump. List what the next person might misread.

blocks.heading: Down / held
rows: Servo fault E214; waiting OEM callback. Do not clear LOTO without lead.
Seal leak; parts on order ETA tomorrow AM. Pan staged under drip.

items.label: Replace CV-4 snub roller next planned stop
PM: F-1 nozzle clean overdue 2 days
items.detail: Slip only if production releases a window.

items.label: Cal due: torque wrench T-12 returned overdue
items.detail: See crib log; do not use on caps until cal cleared.

items.label: Training: new hire shadow on capper changeover

blocks.title: Non-negotiables at handoff
blocks.body: Verbal + written. Walk the LOTO board together. No 'I think it's locked out.' If an asset is down, the tag story and the log story must match before the outgoing crew leaves.

blocks.heading: Five-minute handoff script
items: Read running watch list out loud.
Stand at each down asset; confirm tags and reasons.
Transfer pending owners by name, not by 'someone'.
Note any partial jobs (bolts loose, covers off) that look dangerous if misunderstood.
Incoming lead initials the sheet; outgoing lead keeps a photo or carbon.

blocks.heading: End of shift
blocks.body: Update the three tables, initial the script, and leave the plant more legible than you found it.
